items.child: 25% Discount upto Rs 100 on Movie Tickets.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: 25% Discount upto Rs 100 on Movie Tickets.
benefitRows.offer: Avail of a discount of 25%, upto ₹100 on a minimum purchase of two movie tickets per transaction on www.BookMyShow.com.|You can avail of this offer twice in a month.|Spend ₹25,000 in the preceding calendar quarter to unlock the quota for the current quarter.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: Discount not applicable on convenience fee.
